message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii:**  
- **April–May** (spring)  
- **September–October** (early fall)

### Why those months are ideal

| Month | Typical Weather | Crowds | Prices | Highlights |
|-------|-----------------|--------|--------|------------|
| **April** | 70–80 °F (21–27 °C) highs, 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) lows | Low | Low‑to‑mid | Spring blooms, fewer tourists |
| **May** | 75–85 °F (24–29 °C) highs, 60–70 °F (16–21 °C) lows | Low | Low‑mid | Great surf, clear skies |
| **September** | 80–90 °F (27–32 °C) highs, 65–75 °F (18–24 °C) lows | Low | Low‑mid | Post‑summer calm, good deals |
| **October** | 75–85 °F (24–29 °C) highs, 60–70 °F (16–21 °C) lows | Low | Low‑mid | Fall foliage, fewer crowds |

### Quick recommendation
- **May** if you want the warmest, driest weather with the least crowds.  
- **September** if you prefer slightly cooler temperatures and still want great deals after the summer rush.

Both periods offer pleasant temperatures, lower rainfall, and fewer tourists, making them the sweet spot for most travelers.
